question: Can deterministic code produce one complete, hash-verified and bounded current-main source projection for finite C5 grammar judgement without model-directed source browsing?
decision: Admit the projection for one separately frozen grammar judgement only if every identity, completeness, canonicalisation, size and non-mutation gate passes.

predecessor.decision: The v30/v31 model-read source-window method is inconclusive at its correction cap. Do not rerun or correct it.

construction.canonicalEncoding: UTF-8 JSON, sorted keys, compact separators and one trailing newline.
contents: hashes for the twelve exact current-main inputs
mechanical aspect, card-pool and presentation-free card definitions
top-level combat, player, enemy and card state declarations
the thirteen frozen combat function bodies
the eight frozen policy function bodies
only the immutable Scoreline and Afterimage payoff definitions
the numeric execution and judgement ceilings

successRule: The source is clean at the exact head; every immutable hash matches; all frozen declarations and function bodies are present; the output is canonical valid JSON at or below 60,000 bytes; its embedded byte count is exact; source and ledger identities remain unchanged; and the runner exits zero once.
futilityRule: A complete canonical projection exceeds 60,000 bytes. Close this exact projection method without trimming after observation and continue with a smaller predeclared mechanical vocabulary method.
inconclusiveRule: Any input identity mismatch, dirty source, missing declaration/function, parser or process fault, output collision, timeout, source mutation or ledger mutation yields no source-affordance conclusion. With correction cap zero, do not repair or rerun this protocol.
afterSuccess: Freeze one finite-grammar judgement protocol that reads only the projection, live SSOT/authority and the minimum immutable closure evidence. It may define a bounded grammar but may not instantiate, rank or simulate a candidate until deterministic enumeration is separately frozen.
nonGoals: Do not read a model-selected source window.
Do not infer a mechanism, closure, feasibility, activation or endpoint from projection construction.

Do not construct or rank a candidate, run Godot or the simulator, inspect cache outcomes, add ML/RL, use protected identities, mutate product truth, open a PR, run Actions or create a successor ticket.
